title: The 3 Best Electric Skillets Under $40
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for electric skillets under $40, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric skillets under $40 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Presto 16-Inch Electric Skillet with Glass Cover
products.blurb: Key specs: 16-inch round cast aluminum cooking surface, High-dome glass cover, Removable temperature control probe.
strengths: Cast aluminum resists the hot spots that plague cheaper stamped-steel pans
Simple 5-setting dial has fewer parts to fail than a digital touchscreen
limitations: Fixed settings offer less precision than a numbered temperature dial
No side handles for tilting or easy carrying
Large footprint may be more pan than needed for smaller households

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Family-Sized Electric Skillet SK1215BC
products.blurb: Key specs: 12x15-inch rectangular nonstick surface, Tempered glass lid, Cool-touch handles.
strengths: Rectangular shape fits sandwiches, chops, and other straight-edged foods more efficiently than a round pan
Tilt leg for draining grease is a convenience feature not common at this price
Cool-touch handles make it safer to carry when full
limitations: Nonstick coating wears faster than cast aluminum or ceramic under heavy daily use
Glass lid adds a breakage risk not present with metal lids
Slightly smaller total surface area than the Presto's 16-inch round

products.name: Presto 16-Inch Ceramic Electric Skillet with Glass Cover
strengths: Large 16-inch cooking surface for family meals
Fully immersible for cleaning with the heat control removed
limitations: Ceramic coatings lose slickness with high heat
Edges can run cooler than the center

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
